description: This file defines a test implementation of the TopicsRepository interface for testing purposes in the 'Now in Android' project. It provides mechanisms to emit and retrieve topics data via Kotlin Flows, and includes methods for controlling data during tests.

classes.name: TestTopicsRepository
classes.description: A test implementation of TopicsRepository interface, allowing control over topics data flow for testing scenarios.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of Topic objects representing available topics.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Topic by its ID as a Flow.

methods.name: sendTopics
methods.description: Allows tests to emit a new list of topics to the topicsFlow.

methods.name: syncWith
methods.description: A suspend function that simulates synchronization, returning true.
